Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name
Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures
Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_mechanism.molregno, drug_mechanism.tid = target_dictionary.tid, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4, drug_mechanism.action_type IS 'BLOCKER'
Sort: chembl_id ASC
Limit: NULL
